name: cofish-mobile
description: Native iOS and Android packaging for COFish

scripts.mobile:add:ios: npm run mobile:prepare && cap add ios && node scripts/configure_native_projects.mjs ios
scripts.mobile:add:android: npm run mobile:prepare && cap add android && node scripts/configure_native_projects.mjs android
scripts.mobile:open:ios: npm run mobile:sync && cap open ios
scripts.mobile:open:android: npm run mobile:sync && cap open android
